NEET-UG Exam Paper Leak Probe Focuses on NTA Expert

An investigation into the NEET-UG exam paper leak has identified a National Testing Agency (NTA) subject expert who allegedly provided 132 questions to the son of a coaching centre owner. The expert, a chemistry teacher, reportedly dictated these questions during classes held at a Latur hospital. The probe is examining the extent of the expert's involvement and the potential impact on the exam's integrity.
